prompts.title: Code Review Assistant
prompts.content:
Please review the following code and provide detailed feedback on:
1. Code quality and readability
2. Potential bugs or issues
3. Performance optimizations
4. Security concerns
5. Best practices and design patterns
6. Suggestions for improvement

Code to review:
```
[paste your code here]
```

prompts.title: Explain Like I'm 5
prompts.content: Can you explain [topic/concept] in simple terms that a 5-year-old could understand? Use analogies and examples from everyday life to make it clear and engaging.

prompts.title: Debug Helper
prompts.content:
I'm experiencing the following error/bug:
```
[error message]
```

Context:
- Language/Framework: [specify]
- What I was trying to do: [describe]
- What actually happened: [describe]
- What I expected: [describe]

Code snippet:
```
[relevant code]
```

Please help me identify the root cause and provide a solution.

prompts.title: Unit Test Generator
prompts.content:
Generate comprehensive unit tests for the following function/class. Include:
- Edge cases
- Happy path scenarios
- Error handling
- Boundary conditions
- Mock dependencies if needed

Code to test:
```
[paste your code here]
```

Testing framework preference: [Jest/Mocha/pytest/unittest/etc.]

prompts.title: API Documentation Writer
prompts.content:
Create comprehensive API documentation for the following endpoint(s):

Endpoint details:
- Method: [GET/POST/PUT/DELETE]
- Path: [/api/...]
- Purpose: [describe]

Request format:
```json
[example request]
```

Response format:
```json
[example response]
```

Include:
1. Clear description
2. Parameters (query, path, body)
3. Request/response examples
4. Error codes and messages
5. Authentication requirements
6. Rate limiting info

prompts.title: SQL Query Optimizer
prompts.content:
Analyze and optimize the following SQL query for better performance:

```sql
[paste your query here]
```

Database: [MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite/etc.]
Table sizes: [provide estimates]

Please provide:
1. Optimized version of the query
2. Explanation of changes made
3. Index recommendations
4. Performance impact estimate

prompts.title: Business Email Writer
prompts.content:
Help me write a professional email with the following details:

Purpose: [meeting request/follow-up/proposal/etc.]
Recipient: [client/colleague/manager/etc.]
Key points to cover:
- [point 1]
- [point 2]
- [point 3]

Tone: [formal/semi-formal/friendly]
Desired outcome: [what you want to achieve]

Please make it concise, clear, and action-oriented.

prompts.title: Research Summarizer
prompts.content:
Please analyze and summarize the following research/article/paper:

[paste content or provide link]

Provide:
1. Executive summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Key findings/arguments
3. Methodology (if applicable)
4. Strengths and limitations
5. Practical implications
6. Related topics for further exploration

prompts.title: Creative Story Starter
prompts.content:
Generate a creative story based on these elements:

Genre: [fantasy/sci-fi/mystery/romance/thriller]
Setting: [describe time and place]
Main character: [brief description]
Conflict: [central problem or challenge]
Tone: [dark/humorous/serious/whimsical]

Please create:
1. An engaging opening (200-300 words)
2. Three potential plot directions
3. Key themes to explore
4. Suggested character arc

prompts.title: Refactoring Assistant
prompts.content:
Help me refactor this code to improve:
- Readability
- Maintainability
- Performance
- Following SOLID principles
- Reducing complexity

Current code:
```
[paste your code here]
```

Constraints:
- Must maintain backward compatibility: [yes/no]
- Target language version: [specify]
- Performance requirements: [describe if any]

Please provide the refactored code with explanations for each change.
